build_adsorbate_slab_config: build a python module to generate adsorbate-slab configurations using AdsorbateSlabConfig with random or heuristic mode
create_binding_sites: create a function to sample binding sites on a slab surface using Delaunay triangulation or heuristic methods
place_adsorbate_on_site: place an adsorbate molecule at a specific binding site on a catalyst slab with no atomic overlap
check_atomic_overlap: check if there is atomic overlap between adsorbate and surface atoms using the there_is_overlap function
get_interstitial_distances: get the interstitial distances between all adsorbate and surface atom pairs using covalent radii
